info.name: Dev-ment API — Complete Collection
info.description: Current backend routes, grouped by module and synchronized with src/app/routes/*.routes.ts. Use the accompanying globals or environment; API base URL includes /api/v1. JWT bearer tokens are role-specific. Session refresh and reset password use HttpOnly cookies via Postman's cookie jar. Stripe webhook is invoked by Stripe, not by manual unsigned requests.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication and account recovery. Login issues an access token plus an HttpOnly refresh cookie. The refresh, session and reset-password flows use Postman's cookie jar; they do not accept a refresh token in JSON.

request.description: Candidate login. Save the response data.accessToken as candidateToken in active Postman variables, and let Postman retain the devment_refresh_token cookie.
Requires devment_refresh_token HttpOnly cookie from Login/OTP verification (same Postman host). Bodyless request; refresh rotates the session and sets a new cookie.
Requires Bearer access token AND devment_refresh_token cookie from the same session. Both are required; request has no body.
Use the OTP from the reset email. A successful response sets an HttpOnly reset-session cookie used by Reset Password.
Requires the HttpOnly password-reset cookie issued by Verify Password Reset OTP. Do not send a reset token in the JSON body.
Requires Bearer accessToken.
Verifies devment_refresh_token HttpOnly cookie and Redis session non-destructively; returns {userId, role}. No Bearer token or request body.
Recruiter login. Save response data.accessToken as recruiterToken; refresh cookie is stored in the Postman cookie jar.
Admin login. Save response data.accessToken as adminToken. Use an existing administrator account.

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Role-restricted live summary endpoints for Candidate and Recruiter dashboards.

request.description: Recruiter-only dashboard metrics.
Candidate-only dashboard metrics.

item.name: Question
item.description: Recruiter-only question bank. Create request shape depends on type: MCQ, SHORT_TEXT, LONG_TEXT, or CODING.

request.description: MCQ example. Exactly one option must be correct when selectionMode is SINGLE. For MULTIPLE, at least one option must be correct.
Recruiter-only SHORT_TEXT question. No MCQ options or coding fields.
Recruiter-only LONG_TEXT question.

Describe a scalable API architecture.

", "difficulty": "INTERMEDIATE", "defaultMarks": 15, "evaluationRubric": "Design trade-offs, security, observability." }

request.description: Recruiter-only CODING question. Must include allowedLanguages, execution limits and at least one test case. Creating this question does not execute submitted code.

item.name: Assessment
item.description: Public discovery endpoints and Recruiter-only assessment builder endpoints. Draft creation/sync supports incomplete fields; publishing validates readiness and consumes an assessment credit.

body.raw:
{ "title": "Junior Backend Developer Assessment", "jobRole": "Junior Backend Developer", "descriptionHtml": "

Complete all questions within the given time.

", "skills": ["Node.js", "TypeScript", "PostgreSQL"], "difficulty": "INTERMEDIATE", "durationMinutes": 60, "passPercentage": 60, "suspiciousThreshold": 3 }

request.description: Recruiter only. Only complete valid drafts can be published; publication consumes eligible assessment credits.
Create an incomplete assessment draft; all fields optional. The returned ID is used to sync the draft.
Partially save draft fields. saveMode=AUTO is the default; this is not the publish endpoint.
Manual save of draft fields; saveMode=MANUAL.

item.name: Application
item.description: Candidate applications and recruiter selection workflow. Candidate professional URLs are optional and update candidate profile links on apply.

request.description: Candidate only. Valid assessmentId UUID required. githubUrl, linkedinUrl and portfolioUrl are optional valid URLs; empty strings are not accepted; omitted links are left unchanged.

item.name: Invitation
item.description: Recruiter-managed invitations, candidate email-token verification, and candidate authenticated in-app acceptance by invitation ID.

request.description: Candidate only. Authenticated in-app invitation acceptance by owned invitation UUID; no email token request body. Requires PENDING and unexpired invitation, INVITED application and published assessment.

item.name: Attempt
item.description: Candidate-only timed assessment attempts. Start requires an accepted invitation. Answers use one of three strict shapes (MCQ, text, code).

request.description: Candidate only; valid ACCEPTED invitation required. An attempt cannot be started twice.
MCQ example: selectedOptionIds must be an array of option UUIDs. Choose a request variant matching the actual question type; save only one allowed shape.
Candidate only. Accepted eventType: TAB_HIDDEN, WINDOW_BLUR, FULLSCREEN_EXIT. occurredAt must include UTC offset; clientEventId must be unique.
Use for SHORT_TEXT and LONG_TEXT questions; do not include MCQ or coding fields.
Use for CODING questions; language must be one allowed by that question.

item.name: Evaluation
item.description: Recruiter evaluation workflow and candidate released results. Manual scores are non-negative; finalized results are released separately.

request.description: Recruiter only; releases a finalized evaluation to the candidate.

item.name: Payment
item.description: Pricing plans, recruiter payment history, credits and Stripe checkout. Payment status/credit grants are confirmed by a signed Stripe webhook; success redirect alone is not proof of payment.

request.description: Public Stripe redirect callback, typically redirects (303) to FRONTEND_URL/payment/success?session_id=... when frontend URL configured. Does NOT itself grant credits.
Public Stripe redirect callback; typically 303 to frontend /payment/cancel when FRONTEND_URL is configured.
For Stripe server-to-server delivery only. Requires authentic Stripe-Signature and raw application/json body. Do NOT manually send unsigned requests; payment/credits are finalized via webhook.
Recruiter-only lookup by Stripe Checkout session ID for the logged-in owner. Returns status, paidAt and creditGrant; confirmation requires status=PAID and creditGrant present.

item.name: Profile
item.description: Candidate and Recruiter profile updates plus role-scoped Cloudinary upload-signature generation. Uploaded asset itself goes to Cloudinary.

request.description: Candidate-only. Partial profile update; candidate link fields githubUrl, linkedinUrl, portfolioUrl, resumeUrl accept URL or null.

item.name: Admin
item.description: ADMIN role required for all routes in this collection. Some operations alter user access, pricing, credits, or company verification.

request.description: ADMIN only. Destructive/irreversible user management action; run against test data with care.
ADMIN only. Grants manual assessment credits to specified recruiter profile and records an audit event.
